title: tinytable-eval findings.json
description: Output contract for the tinytable-eval task-prompt.md: a JSON array of defects found in tinytable relative to SPEC.md, or an empty array if none were found.

id.description: A short, stable slug identifying this finding, e.g. "null-eq-match".

summary.description: One or two sentences describing the deviation from SPEC.md.

spec_section.description: The SPEC.md section this finding's expected behavior comes from.

repro_test.description: The pytest node id (relative to the repo root) of the test under tests/agent/ that reproduces this exact finding.
